# Nimtto

> Nimtto (निम्तो, "invitation" in Nepali) is an online invitation maker from Nepal. It makes invitation websites (digital invitation cards, e-invitations) for Nepali weddings and every family occasion: engagement, bratabandha, gunyu cholo, pasni, nwaran, birthdays, janku, bhoj and receptions. Each invitation works in English and Nepali, shows Bikram Sambat and AD dates, every event with a map, RSVP, music and photos, and is shared as one link on WhatsApp, Viber or Messenger. No app is needed.

## Key facts
- Website: https://nimtto.com
- Based in: Nepal; serves Nepali families worldwide
- Contact: WhatsApp and phone +977 980-6393298, email nimttoz@gmail.com (English and Nepali)
- Payment: Khalti, eSewa, bank QR (Fonepay), or PayPal in US dollars from abroad. Order online, pay by QR, upload the payment screenshot; Nimtto confirms it.
- Ordering creates a customer account (email and password) to pay later, edit the invitation and read guest replies.

## Prices (one payment, no monthly fee)
- Saral: Rs 2,999 (USD 49 from abroad). A ready-made design; Your names, date and venue; Guest replies (RSVP); A link to share on WhatsApp.
- Shubha: Rs 4,999 (USD 99 from abroad). Everything in Saral; Photos and your story; Every ceremony with maps; Music and the opening scene.
- Shahi: Rs 6,999 (USD 149 from abroad). Everything in Shubha; Premium designs; Personal guest links; Priority help until the wedding.
- Custom: from Rs 11,111 (USD 199 from abroad). A design made for your occasion; Your colours, art and wording; Everything in Shahi.

## Wedding designs (27), by the lowest plan that includes them
- Saral: Kham (खाम), Mala (माला), Phoolbari (फूलबारी), Dhaka (ढाका), Sayapatri (सयपत्री), Chitra (चित्र), Jhyal (झ्याल)
- Shubha: Dhoka (ढोका), Durbar (दरबार), Himal (हिमाल), Mandap (मण्डप), Bagaicha (बगैंचा), Ghar (घर), Mangal (मंगल), Nimantrana (निमन्त्रणा)
- Shahi: Mahal (महल), Laali (लाली), Mehendi (मेहन्दी), Hariyo (हरियो), Shree (श्री), Pardaa (पर्दा), Rajdwar (राजद्वार), Agni (अग्नि), Janti (जन्ती), Swayambar (स्वयम्बर), Sindoor (सिन्दूर), Rangoli (रंगोली)

## Occasions
- Wedding (शुभ विवाह, बिहे): 27 ready designs, with every ceremony from mehendi to reception. Ready-made designs.
- Engagement (सगाई, टीका): The tika, the rings and the family lunch, in one link. Designed for you on the Custom plan.
- Bratabandha (ब्रतबन्ध): The sacred thread day, with the full programme and the feast. Designed for you on the Custom plan.
- Gunyu Cholo (गुन्यू चोलो): A daughter’s first gunyu cholo, shared with the whole family. Designed for you on the Custom plan.
- Pasni (पास्नी, अन्नप्राशन): Baby’s first rice, with photos and the time of the feast. Designed for you on the Custom plan.
- Nwaran (न्वारान): The naming day. The new name appears as guests open it. Designed for you on the Custom plan.
- Birthday (जन्मदिन): From a first birthday to an 84th, in English and Nepali. Designed for you on the Custom plan.
- Janku (जंकु): The Newar old-age rites that honour an elder, from Bhimratha on. Designed for you on the Custom plan.
- Bhoj and reception (भोज): A reception or family feast, with a map and replies for numbers. Designed for you on the Custom plan.
- Your own occasion (आफ्नै अवसर): Griha pravesh, a puja, an anniversary. Designed for you. Designed for you on the Custom plan.

## Questions and answers
### What is Nimtto?
Nimtto is an online invitation maker from Nepal. We make invitation websites for weddings, bratabandha, pasni, gunyu cholo and other family occasions. Your guests open one link on their phone and see every event, the date in Nepali and English, a map, your photos and a reply form.

### How do I make an online wedding invitation in Nepal?
Choose a design on Nimtto, fill the short order form and pay by QR. We then message you on WhatsApp for your names, dates, photos and song, and send you the finished link to share.

### How much does a digital wedding card cost in Nepal?
A Nimtto invitation website costs Rs 2,999 (Saral), Rs 4,999 (Shubha) or Rs 6,999 (Shahi). A custom design made only for you starts at Rs 11,111. From abroad you can pay in US dollars by PayPal, from USD 49.

### Do you make invitations for bratabandha, pasni and other occasions?
Yes. Besides weddings, we make invitation websites for engagement, bratabandha, gunyu cholo, pasni, nwaran, birthdays, janku, bhoj and receptions, and any family occasion. These are designed for you on the Custom plan.

### Can the invitation be in Nepali?
Yes. Every invitation works in English and Nepali, and guests switch with one tap. Dates show in Bikram Sambat and AD side by side.

### Can guests reply to the invitation?
Yes. Guests tell you if they are coming, to which events and how many people. You read every reply in your own dashboard and can download the list.

### Do guests need to install an app?
No. The invitation is a website. It opens in any phone browser from WhatsApp, Viber, Messenger or SMS, also on slow mobile data.

### How long does it take?
We start as soon as your payment is confirmed and we have your details. A ready-made design is quicker than a custom one. Tell us your date when you order and we plan around it.

### What is the difference between Saral, Shubha and Shahi?
The plans differ in which designs and extras they include. Saral has 7 designs and all the basics. Shubha adds 8 more designs, photos, every ceremony with maps and music. Shahi includes every design, personal guest links and priority help.

### How do I pay?
You pay by Khalti, eSewa or any bank app by scanning a QR code, or by PayPal from abroad. After you order, the payment page shows the QR with your order number. You then upload a screenshot of the payment and we confirm it.

### Can family abroad see it and pay from abroad?
Yes. The invitation opens anywhere in the world, and you can pay in US dollars by PayPal.

### What is a custom design?
A custom design is a new invitation made only for you, with your colours, art and wording. It suits any occasion, not only weddings. It starts at Rs 11,111 and we talk it through with you before we begin.

### Why do I make an account when I order?
Your account lets you come back to your order, pay later, and later edit your invitation and read guest replies. You sign in with your email and the password you choose.

### Can I change details after the invitation is shared?
Yes. The link stays the same and changes show at once. You can update times, venues and photos from your dashboard, or message us and we change it for you.
